question: Where do the two Caṇḍa deities stand in relation to the doors?
premises: Devī and two Caṇḍas are named.
They are at the doors of the four-faced shrine.
inference: The Caṇḍa deities guard the doors on both sides.
uncertainties: Exact door count is not specified.
plain_english: Devī and the two Caṇḍas stand on both sides of the doors in the four-faced shrine.
